Reject another administrator’s pending correction without changing Coin
Retract the acting administrator’s pending correction without changing Coin

get.summary: Read private bot settings, current readiness and previous runtime observations
Every registered release setting with its status and value, in registry order; `status=undecided` lists the ones with no value
Release setting changes, newest first: before and after, reason, admin and time (of one key with `key`)

patch.summary: Set the status and value of a release setting with a reason (recorded); `undecided` takes no value, the others require one that fits the item, and a change to the current status and value is refused

schema.description: A category slug on either level; a top-level slug lists every sub-category under it

get.summary: Markets by status (default open; all is every public status), never draft or in review, optionally by category and a search (q: a title partial match, case-insensitive, or a tag of exactly that name, case and spaces aside); sorted recommended (24-hour volume, then the latest opening; the default), newest (latest opening) or closing (soonest close; with all or an ended status, the markets not closed yet (scheduled, open, paused) first and then the ended ones, latest close first)

schema.description: A market id (uuid) or slug; a slug is NFC-normalised before the 80-character bound, so a decomposed spelling may be longer on the wire

get.summary: One market by id or slug, with its tags in order and its rule versions, the current first (each one’s full text, changed items, reason and time, and nobody’s name), and its market price as of 24 hours ago (the last fill by then, null with none). Includes an anonymous judging record: approved versions and grounds, pause and delay history, dispute counts and decision reasons, cancellation and payout delay; no operator identity, unapproved judgement, approval reason or dispute submission. A draft or in-review one is NOT_FOUND to the public
Newest 20 fills, anonymous: each one’s contract, price, YES value, quantity, amount and server time — no account, order, taker side or account type

Markets linked to this one (links are two-way): every public status but cancelled, never one whose result is VOID, sorted recommended (24-hour volume, then the latest opening); a draft, in-review or unknown market is NOT_FOUND

Price series, ascending, at most 500 points. Every point is a fill: its YES value in basis points at its server time (the open and a judgement are no point). `raw` returns the fills, downsampled from the newest 10000 of the range (`truncated` says when older ones were left out). `1m`/`1h` sample the price in force on an absolute grid, coarsening the stride until the window fits; `bucketSeconds` reports the stride served, and the point at `from` carries the last fill at or before it, if any — before the first fill the series starts empty.
Active categories in display order: top-level rows (parentId null) first, then their sub-categories

post.summary: Record a draft liquidity version with a reason; review and opening lock it

get.summary: Every market, draft and in-review ones included, newest first; q narrows it to titles holding the term (a case-insensitive partial match), as the related-market picker searches

post.summary: Create a draft market (no price until its first fill) with up to 5 tags in order; a new tag name makes the tag, one differing only in case or spaces links the existing tag; rule items and times not sent start blank; times out of order are refused naming both ends

get.summary: The markets linked to this one, any status, the latest link first, with who linked

post.summary: Link another market to this one, two-way, in any status of either; linking a linked pair changes nothing. Answers the links as they stand

delete.summary: Unlink two markets; unlinking a pair that is not linked changes nothing. Answers the path market's links as they stand

get.summary: One market with its tags, exposure, settlement steps, event log, what the open-items check finds missing, its review (the pending request, the creator, the editors, the unfinished markets with the same conditions and the review log), its rule versions with who asked for and made each and its supplement requests (the waiting one and the log)

patch.summary: Edit a draft (any field) or an open or paused market (its category, tags and image only: slug refused naming the field, no tags refused naming tags, and its title, rule items and times — its rule version’s items — change by a supplement alone, each one changed refused naming it); tags and fallbackSources replace the whole ordered list; other statuses refuse naming status — review and scheduled are locked (send back to a draft to edit; reschedule moves a scheduled open)

post.summary: draft → review (검수 제출): refused with OPEN_ITEMS_MISSING when the open-items check finds the title, a rule item, a time, the time order, the lead close, the category or the tags missing, then with a past closeAt; opens the review request another admin decides, stores the lead-close gap it checked against and locks the content (no edit in review or scheduled)

review → scheduled (승인) by an admin who neither created, edited nor submitted the market, every checklist item confirmed, with a reason; the open-items check and the close are checked again. The market becomes public as scheduled — and opens at once (status open) when its scheduled open has passed; otherwise it opens at its scheduled open
review → draft (반려) by an admin who may approve it, with a reason from the list and a description the creator reads in the review log

review or scheduled → draft (되돌리기) by any admin, with a reason, to edit and review again; in review the pending request is retracted when its submitter sends the market back and rejected with the reason when anyone else does

Move a scheduled market’s scheduled open without a new review, with a reason; it stays before the close in whole minutes, and an instant already passed opens the market at once (status open: there is no early open, move the scheduled open earlier instead); once the close has passed it is refused (closeAt) — send the market back to a draft (revert) to fix its times

Change an open or paused market’s price-protection width in ticks (1..98), with a reason, by one admin; recorded with the value before and after, it applies to the immediate orders taken after it and never to resting ones

get.summary: Read the acting administrator’s trading interest and immutable declarations for a market

post.summary: Declare the acting administrator’s interest irrevocably, retracting their pending judgement or correction atomically

get.summary: The markets waiting for review (REVIEW, with their pending request), the oldest submission first: who submitted and when, who created the market, its category, scheduled open and close

post.summary: Request a supplement of an open or paused market’s rules (보충 요청), against its current rule version: the new value of each item to change (the title, a rule item, the close — later only and never while paused —, the announcement or the zone; the scheduled open and judgement are fixed), the reason and the settlement impact review. Another admin decides it; nothing changes until then, and one request waits per market at a time

Approve a waiting supplement (승인) by an admin other than its requester, with a reason: everything it was checked against is checked again, then the market takes the new text and the next rule version — the full text, the changed items and the reason, public in the detail’s history — and its status is republished unchanged for viewers to refetch

Reject a waiting supplement (반려) by an admin other than its requester, in any status, with a reason from the list — meaning_change when it would change the market’s meaning, which goes to the pause procedure — and a description; nothing changes
Retract a waiting supplement the acting admin requested (철회), in any status, before anyone decides it; nothing changes

get.summary: The supplement requests waiting for a decision, the oldest first, with their market (its status and close too: one still waiting at the close is shown for its 반려 or 철회), who asked and when, the rule version it was written against and the items it changes

post.summary: Pause an open market’s trading (거래 일시 중단) by one admin, at once: one of the three reasons, a public note with explicit publicNoteConfirmed=true and, for an early result, when the result was published — not after the pause. The close still comes on schedule; resuming or closing early is another admin’s approval of a next-path request

Ask for a paused market’s next path (재개·조기 마감 요청): the pause the admin saw (refused once it is no longer the current one), resume or close early, the review result for a pause on a basis change (not judgeable: close early only) and the reason. Another admin decides it; nothing changes until then, and one request waits per market at a time

Approve a waiting next path (승인) by an admin other than its requester, with a reason: the market resumes trading (open) or closes early (closed; the scheduled close is kept and the judgement follows — or cancelled, with no result and no judgement, when no person filled), the pause ends, and the status is published
Reject a waiting next path (반려) by an admin other than its requester, in any status, with a reason; nothing changes and the market stays as it is
Retract a waiting next path the acting admin requested (철회), in any status, before anyone decides it; nothing changes

get.summary: The next-path requests of paused markets waiting for a decision, the oldest first, with their market (its status and close too: one still waiting at the close is shown for its 반려 or 철회), the pause’s reason, the path and review result asked for, and who asked and when

post.summary: Ask to cancel a scheduled market (시장 취소 요청) with a reason — the cancel’s public reason. Another admin decides it; nothing changes until then, the scheduled open is not held, and one request waits per market at a time

Approve a waiting cancel request (승인) by an admin other than its requester, with a reason: the scheduled market is cancelled without opening (cancelled; no result, judgement or payout), its open and close jobs are removed, and the status is published
Reject a waiting cancel request (반려) by an admin other than its requester, in any status, with a reason; nothing changes and the market stays as it is
Retract a waiting cancel request the acting admin made (철회), in any status, before anyone decides it; nothing changes

get.summary: The cancel requests of scheduled markets waiting for a decision, the oldest first, with their market (its status, scheduled open and close too: one still waiting after the open is shown for its 반려 or 철회), the reason, and who asked and when

post.summary: Register a closed market’s judgement (판정 등록) for another admin’s approval: the result (YES, NO or VOID), the rules’ source by its priority (0 the primary, 1–3 a fallback with the reason the primary could not be used; none for a VOID alone, with its reason), 1–5 evidence links, when the evidence was collected (not after now) and what was confirmed. With `correction` — the current judgement version and the correction reason — it registers a provisional market’s correction (판정 정정) the same way, the whole new judgement in the body: refused when it changes neither the result nor its grounds, and while it waits the result is not confirmed. Nothing else changes until the approval; one registration waits per market at a time

Approve a waiting judgement (승인) by an admin other than its registrant, with a reason — before the scheduled judgement time also confirming the NO condition’s event deadline: the provisional result is published (closed → provisional) and the dispute deadline fixed (now plus the dispute window); the worker confirms the result once it has passed with no judgement dispute pending or accepted and no correction waiting for its approval. A correction’s approval makes the next judgement version instead — the market stays provisional with the new result, a new dispute deadline of the first one’s length from now, and the replaced version’s pending disputes closed

Reject a waiting judgement (반려) by an admin other than its registrant, in any status, with a reason; the market stays as it is — a closed one is registered again, by any admin. A rejected correction leaves the judgement version, its dispute deadline and its disputes’ results as they were, sends the accepted disputes it answered back to pending, and once that deadline has passed with nothing holding the market the worker confirms the original result within seconds

Retract a waiting judgement the acting admin registered (철회), in any status, before anyone decides it; a first judgement’s retraction changes nothing else, and a correction’s ends as its rejection does: the accepted disputes it answered go back to pending, and once the dispute deadline has passed with nothing holding the market the worker confirms the original result within seconds

get.summary: The judgement registrations waiting for approval, the oldest first, with their market (its status, close and scheduled judgement time too: one still waiting once the market left the status it needs is shown for its 반려 or 철회), the result registered, whether it is a correction (its base version, reason and the accepted disputes it answers), and who registered it and when

post.summary: Record why a delayed market’s judgement is late and when it is next reviewed (판정 지연 기록) by one admin, at once: on a closed market past its scheduled judgement or a provisional one a dispute or a waiting correction holds past its dispute deadline, a public reason and a next review time after now and at most 7 days ahead. Each record is a new one — the earlier ones stay as history, none is edited or withdrawn — and the public detail shows the current one without who recorded it. Nothing of the market changes: no status, no result, no scheduled judgement, and the time passing creates nothing

Dispute a provisional result (판정 이의) while the dispute deadline is ahead: the judgement version the screen showed, 1–5 evidence links and a reason (1–2,000 characters), by a member with a fill on the market (either side); one per member and judgement version, a retracted one included. Answers the dispute, pending; the market stays provisional past its deadline until every dispute is dismissed or retracted

get.summary: The account's judgement disputes (판정 이의), newest first, each with its market (and its current judgement version: a dispute of an older one was answered by a correction), the links and reason it submitted, its status, the decision’s reason and time — or when a correction closed it — and whether it may still be retracted

The dispute screen’s state of one market: whether the account may dispute its current judgement version now (eligible, or the first reason a submission would be refused for), that version, and the account’s dispute of it whatever its status

post.summary: Retract one of the account’s disputes (철회) while it is pending and its deadline is ahead, signed in whatever the onboarding; it stays the one of its judgement version

Dismiss a pending judgement dispute (기각) by an admin who did not register its judgement version, with a reason the submitter reads; once no dispute holds the market and its dispute deadline has passed, the worker confirms the result within seconds

Accept a pending judgement dispute (수용) by an admin who did not register its judgement version, with a reason the submitter reads: accepting is a correction, and the market stays provisional — the accepted dispute holding it — until a correction is registered and approved; if another admin rejects that correction or its registrant retracts it, the dispute goes back to pending

get.summary: Judgement disputes (이의 접수): pending ones the oldest first (status=pending, the default), or those dismissed, accepted, retracted or closed by a correction the latest first (status=decided), each with its market (and its current judgement version), judgement version, submitter, links, reason and decision

Every position of the account, most recently changed first. status=open keeps the unsettled rows (qty may be 0 after a full sell), status=settled the settled ones; omitted lists all. No cursor: bounded by the markets one account has touched.

The account's holding of a market, YES then NO, with what it may sell now: the contracts held, the part in its resting sells (shown apart, never quoted) and the rest quoted as an immediate sell with price protection (null when nothing is free or the market has no width; fewer filled than free means only part can sell now). Zeros when nothing is held; a market not open, or past its trading close, answers a rejected quote with its reason

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: The request id: client-generated, unique per account. Re-sending it with the same market and terms answers the order it named (replayed: true) and writes nothing; with other terms DUPLICATE_REQUEST (409, the id is spent). A refusal with an error writes no order, so its id may be sent again. GET /me/orders/request/{requestId} reads the order.

post.summary: Place an order: buy or sell YES or NO, immediate (ioc: fills what it can now, the rest is cancelled) or limit (gtc: the rest waits), always with a limit price 1–99 — an immediate order’s narrowed to the best opposite quote ± the market’s price-protection width — and a quantity of 1–1,000,000 contracts or, for an immediate buy only, a Coin budget. Answers the order: taken, or rejected with its reason (not an error). The same Idempotency-Key with the same terms answers that order as it stands now (replayed)

get.summary: The account's orders, newest first, rejected ones included, each with what filled and its state and reason; marketId narrows to one market, state=live to the waiting and partly filled ones, state=ended to the rest
The account’s order its request id (the Idempotency-Key it was sent with) named — what became of a request whose answer was lost. NOT_FOUND when it named none
One of the account’s orders; another account’s is NOT_FOUND

post.summary: Cancel one of the account’s waiting or partly filled orders: its whole remaining quantity at once, inside this request (no "requested" state), its lock released and what filled kept. Answers the order in its final state; one that had ended answers as it is. Another account’s is NOT_FOUND; MARKET_NOT_OPEN while its market is held for a ledger failure (the recovery approval ends it: cancelled, reason paused, at a resume or early close; expired when the market closed before its recovery, #93). Not counted by the order rate limit, and open while order intake is closed

get.summary: The account's fills, newest first, each as its own order took it: the order, outcome, side, quantity, price per contract and Coin, the recorded YES price and the fee (0). The counterparty is never named; marketId narrows to one market

The public order book, YES then NO: every price level of each side with its summed quantity — asks (what a buyer meets: the direct sells and the other outcome’s buys at 100 − their price, merged per price, cheapest first) and bids (the direct buys only, highest first) — and the best of each, null when the side is empty. No order, account or order count. A market not open, or past its trading close, shows empty sides with marketRejectReason (not_open_yet, paused, closed)

post.summary: Quote an order on the book as it stands, as the order intake would match it, writing nothing: the limit it would match with (an immediate order’s narrowed to the best opposite quote ± the market’s price-protection width; with none sent, 99 for a buy and 1 for a sell — send it as the order’s limit), the contracts filling at once and their Coin, what is left, a buy’s whole lock, the fee (0), why the walk stopped and the state the order would end in. A market not open, or past its trading close, answers a rejected quote with its reason. Public: no session, and open while order intake is closed

schema.description: A category slug on either level; a top-level slug lists every sub-category under it

get.summary: Markets the account watches, every public status unless status narrows it (an ended market stays until unwatched); category takes either level like GET /markets; sorted watched (most recently watched first, the default) or by the GET /markets orders
Whether the account watches one market (a draft or in-review one is NOT_FOUND)

put.summary: Watch or unwatch one market in any public status; repeating either changes nothing (a draft or in-review one is NOT_FOUND)

get.summary: The account's recent searches: the newest 10 distinct terms, newest first

post.summary: Record one submitted search of the account; answers its recent searches (the newest 10 distinct terms, newest first)
Delete one recent search: every recorded search of the entry's term (an id the account has none of deletes nothing); answers the recent searches (the newest 10 distinct terms, newest first)
Delete every recorded search of the account; answers the (empty) recent searches

get.summary: Published themes: ongoing ones by the soonest end, then upcoming ones by the soonest start, then ended ones by the latest end; status narrows them to one of the three, read on the Korean date (both dates of the period are in it)

schema.description: A theme id (uuid) or slug; a slug is NFC-normalised before the 80-character bound

get.summary: A published theme's page by slug or id: introduction, period and status, and its shown notices, newest first; an unpublished or unknown theme is NOT_FOUND
The theme's markets in every public status, cancelled ones too (never draft or in review): those not closed yet first, soonest close first, then the ended ones, latest close first
The theme's markets whose result is confirmed (resolved, settling or settled; never provisional) with that result (YES, NO or VOID), the most recently confirmed first
The published themes this market is in, any status, in the public list order; a draft, in-review or unknown market is NOT_FOUND
Every theme, published or not, newest first

post.summary: Create an unpublished theme: slug, name, introduction and Korean period, all required, dates from 2000-01-01 to 2100-12-31; a slug another theme has is refused naming slug

get.summary: One theme with who made it and every notice, hidden ones too

patch.summary: Edit the name, introduction or period at any time, and the slug until the theme is first published (refused naming slug after that, unpublished or not); an end before the start is refused naming the half the body sent (start == end is a one-day theme), and a date outside 2000-01-01 to 2100-12-31 naming its field

post.summary: Make the theme public; refused naming markets while it has no public market (draft and in-review ones do not count); a published theme stays as it is
Take the theme off every public answer (it is never deleted)

get.summary: The theme's markets, any status, the latest put in first, with who put it in

post.summary: Put a market in the theme, in any status; a market already in changes nothing. Answers the theme's markets as they stand

delete.summary: Take a market out of the theme; a market not in changes nothing. Answers the theme's markets as they stand

post.summary: Write a notice on the theme's page, plain text, shown at once. Answers the theme

patch.summary: Edit a notice's title or body; the earlier text stays in the admin record. Answers the theme

post.summary: Take a notice off the public page (it is never deleted). Answers the theme
Show a hidden notice on the page again. Answers the theme

get.summary: Every account that holds the admin role now, with its latest grant

post.summary: Make an account an admin with a reason (recorded); only an account with a verified email that has verified its mobile number

get.summary: Read trade history and pending order counts before granting an admin role
Admin grants and revokes, newest first: account, admin, reason and time (of one account with `userId`)

post.summary: Take the admin role from an account (one's own included) with a reason (recorded) and sign it out everywhere; refused when fewer than two admins would remain

get.summary: Counts of the verification texts: sent (against the daily service limit), unanswered and refused, in the last 24 hours and per Korean day for seven days

post.summary: Record consent answers: the items the consent step asks, or the marketing one alone
Set or confirm the nickname in the onboarding, and grant the start Coin
Answer the onboarding interests step: categories picked, or none to skip it

put.summary: Set the interest categories in MY settings (none: drop them all)

schema.description: A category slug on either level; a top-level slug lists every sub-category under it

get.summary: The community list: every market’s posts, newest first (the only order), never a deleted or hidden one; narrowed by market, by category (either level, like GET /markets) and by q, a case-insensitive partial match in the title or the text

post.summary: A post on a market in any public status: an optional title and a formatted body (at most 5000 characters of text and 10 images, each an upload of the author’s own); formatting outside the allow-list is removed. Refused under a writing restriction (RESTRICTED, with its end)

get.summary: A post page: the whole post, or a placeholder for a hidden post and for a deleted one that comments not deleted (hidden ones too) still hang under; a deleted post with none is NOT_FOUND

put.summary: The author replaces the title and the body (never the market); the post shows as edited and the earlier version is kept for operators. The same content changes nothing. A hidden post cannot be edited (POST_NOT_EDITABLE), nor any under a writing restriction (RESTRICTED, with its end — asked first). Deleting stays open

post.summary: The author deletes the post (a hidden one too), signed in whatever their onboarding: it stays as the placeholder 삭제된 글입니다 while comments not deleted (hidden ones too) hang under it, and is gone from every view otherwise. Never restored

get.summary: A market’s discussion: its posts as the community list’s cards, newest first, never a deleted or hidden one, and meta.total, how many the whole list holds; readable in every public status, ended markets too. A draft, in-review or unknown market is NOT_FOUND

post.summary: An image for a post (or an admin’s notice): JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF by its content, at most 5242880 bytes, its long side at most 32 times its short side. Stored without its metadata, the long side at most 2048px (a still WebP with alpha at most 3400000 pixels), a GIF still moving. Its id goes into the post’s image node; it is served once a post shows it, and removed if nothing takes it within 24 hours. Refused under a writing restriction (RESTRICTED, with its end), which no post of the account gets past — but for an admin’s notice (`purpose=notice`, an admin’s alone): a writing restriction refuses no notice, its images included

get.summary: An image a post or a pinned notice shows, or a member’s profile image (NOT_FOUND for any other: not attached, removed by an edit, of a deleted or hidden post, of a notice not pinned, or no profile’s image now). Revalidated on every use (ETag)

schema.description: Opaque, sealed for this post’s list; `meta.nextCursor` of the previous page.

get.summary: A post’s comments: its 댓글 oldest first, at most 20 a page, each with its first 50 대댓글 oldest first and the cursor of the rest (repliesNextCursor, for GET /comments/:commentId/replies); a deleted 댓글 that 대댓글 hang under and a hidden comment are placeholders, other deleted ones are left out. The cursors are opaque, sealed for their list: one that does not open is VALIDATION_ERROR. A post that is gone is NOT_FOUND

post.summary: A comment of plain text (at most 1000 characters, line breaks kept): a 댓글, or with parentId a 대댓글 — under the 댓글 named, or under the 댓글 of the 대댓글 named. A hidden or deleted post or 댓글 takes none (COMMENT_NOT_ALLOWED); an author under a writing restriction writes none (RESTRICTED, with its end — asked first)

schema.description: Opaque, sealed for this 댓글’s list; the thread’s `repliesNextCursor`, or `meta.nextCursor` of the previous page.

get.summary: The 대댓글 of a 댓글 after the cursor, oldest first, 50 a page — the first page is the one its post’s comment page carries. A deleted 대댓글 is left out and a hidden one is its placeholder. The cursor is opaque, sealed for this 댓글’s list: another list’s, or one that does not open, is VALIDATION_ERROR. NOT_FOUND for an unknown comment, a 대댓글 and a 댓글 that is gone

put.summary: The author replaces the body; the comment shows as edited and the earlier version is kept for operators. The same text changes nothing. A hidden comment cannot be edited (COMMENT_NOT_EDITABLE), nor any under a writing restriction (RESTRICTED, with its end — asked first). Deleting stays open

post.summary: The author deletes the comment (a hidden one too): a 댓글 stays as the placeholder 삭제된 글입니다 while 대댓글 hang under it, and anything else is gone from every view. Never restored

put.summary: Like a post (liked: true) or take the like back (false); repeating either changes nothing. One like per person: per account and per verified number. One’s own post too, in any public market status. A deleted post’s placeholder and a hidden post take none (LIKE_NOT_ALLOWED). Answers the state and the post’s like count — not liked, nothing written, when another live account’s like holds the verified number’s place

Like a 댓글 or a 대댓글 (liked: true) or take the like back (false), as a post’s like. A deleted 댓글’s placeholder and a hidden comment take none (LIKE_NOT_ALLOWED). Answers the state and the comment’s like count

get.summary: Whether the account likes a post and which of the comments under it it likes (by its account, or by its verified number for a like a withdrawn account left); no count and nobody else’s
The pinned notices (at most 3), the latest pinned first: the fixed area above the community list
A pinned notice’s page: its title, body and dates (NOT_FOUND for a notice not pinned, as for an unknown one)
The notices of one state: pinned (the fixed area, the latest pinned first) or unpinned (every other notice, the newest first — each may be pinned again)

post.summary: Write a notice, not pinned: a required title and a formatted body as a post’s (at most 5000 characters of text and 10 images, each an upload of the admin’s own that no post or notice has taken)

get.summary: One notice, pinned or not, as the editor loads it

put.summary: Replace a notice’s title and body: it shows as edited and the earlier version is kept for operators. The same content changes nothing (`changed: false`). A pinned notice stays pinned. Refused when the notice was saved since the version the edit was opened from, whoever saved it (`expectedEditedAt`, NOTICE_EDIT_CONFLICT)

get.summary: A notice’s operation records, newest first: who wrote, edited, pinned or unpinned it and when (an edit names the version it replaced). An unknown notice has none
A notice’s earlier versions, newest first: each title, when and by whom it was written and replaced. An unknown notice has none

schema.description: An earlier version’s id: a positive integer

get.summary: One earlier version of a notice, whole, to read (NOT_FOUND if not this notice’s)
An image the notice holds, now or in an earlier version, pinned or not (NOT_FOUND for any other). Revalidated on every use (ETag)

post.summary: Pin a notice above the community list, on top; refused while 3 are pinned (NOTICE_PIN_LIMIT_REACHED — none is unpinned to make room). A pinned one changes nothing
Unpin a notice: out of the fixed area and out of the public (its page and images answer NOT_FOUND), kept on the admin screen, and may be pinned again. One not pinned changes nothing

schema.description: A member’s public id (10 lower-case letters and digits, never the account id), matched ignoring case; anything else is NOT_FOUND

get.summary: A member’s public profile: the nickname, the image, the 운영자 mark, the bio, the interest categories, the month joined, and the counts of visible posts, comments and the likes they received; an unknown public id is NOT_FOUND

put.summary: Set the public profile’s image: JPEG, PNG or WebP by its content, at most 5242880 bytes, its long side at most 32 times its short side. Stored without its metadata as the square cropped from its middle, scaled down to 512px when larger (never enlarged); the earlier image is removed

post.summary: Delete the public profile’s image (the nickname’s first letter is shown instead); removed at once

schema.description: A member’s public id (10 lower-case letters and digits, never the account id), matched ignoring case; anything else is NOT_FOUND

get.summary: A member’s posts on their profile, newest first, as the community list’s cards: never a deleted or hidden one; those on ended, cancelled and VOID markets included, and all of them while the member is under a restriction. An unknown public id is NOT_FOUND, as the profile

schema.description: A member’s public id (10 lower-case letters and digits, never the account id), matched ignoring case; anything else is NOT_FOUND

get.summary: A member’s 댓글 and 대댓글 on their profile, newest first, each with the post it sits under (a placeholder by its id alone) and its market: never a deleted or hidden one, those under a hidden or deleted post included. An unknown public id is NOT_FOUND
The account’s own posts, newest first, as the community list’s cards with `hidden` (and its reason) on one an operator hid; never a deleted one
The account’s own 댓글 and 대댓글, newest first, each with its post and market, with `hidden` (and its reason) on one an operator hid; never a deleted one

post.summary: Report a 근거 글. One reason (기타 needs a description). Refused: one’s own (own), the same person’s report on it still pending (duplicate), a deleted placeholder or a hidden item (deleted, hidden), and more than 20 in 24 hours per person (REPORT_LIMITED, none for an operator). Nothing is hidden by a report; an operator decides. Answers the report as the reporter’s list shows it

Report a 댓글 or a 대댓글. One reason (기타 needs a description). Refused: one’s own (own), the same person’s report on it still pending (duplicate), a deleted placeholder or a hidden item (deleted, hidden), and more than 20 in 24 hours per person (REPORT_LIMITED, none for an operator). Nothing is hidden by a report; an operator decides. Answers the report as the reporter’s list shows it

schema.description: A member’s public id (10 lower-case letters and digits, never the account id), matched ignoring case; anything else is NOT_FOUND

post.summary: Report a member’s public profile (its nickname, image and 소개). An unknown public id is NOT_FOUND, as the profile. One reason (기타 needs a description). Refused: one’s own (own), the same person’s report on it still pending (duplicate), and more than 20 in 24 hours per person (REPORT_LIMITED, none for an operator). Nothing is hidden by a report; an operator decides. Answers the report as the reporter’s list shows it

get.summary: The account’s own reports, newest first: what each was about as the public sees it now (a placeholder by its id alone), the reason and description sent, and the result — pending, actioned (조치함) or dismissed (기각) — with when. Never the action taken nor who took it

The actions operators took on the account, newest first: the type, the reason (a report reason — or an account restriction’s own — and the operator’s explanation), what it was about (the account’s own item, nothing of it once deleted), its end when it has one — for a writing or an account restriction an operator lifted early or shortened, that kind and the end it was given — and its cancellation. An account restriction is here once another admin approved it. Never the operator, the approving admin, a report, a reporter, nor why an end changed

The restrictions that govern the account now, each as a refusal names it: the writing restriction (`restriction`, what a refused post, comment or edit names) and the account restriction (`accountRestriction`, what a refused order names) — its kind and its end (null: none, until it is lifted), the latest end of those standing, one with no end over any. Null when none of that kind stands; an account restriction not yet approved is none. Never the operator, the reason nor a report

The report queue, grouped by target: `pending` (default) — targets with a pending report, the one waiting longest first — or `resolved` — targets whose reports were all processed, the latest first. Each with the target now, its member, the counts per reason and times

post.summary: Dismiss (기각) the reports named, each pending, with a reason (recorded): nothing is done to anyone and the reporters read 기각. A report on the acting admin’s own item or profile is another admin’s (own); one processed already is `resolved`

get.summary: Every moderation action, newest first, with its reason, operator, time and cancellation — no operator on an action taken on the admin reading it (`aboutViewer`)

post.summary: Cancel an action with a reason (recorded): a hidden item shows again; a profile item is not restored. A nickname reset’s cancellation restores no nickname but hands the hold of the nickname taken away to the member: other accounts stay held for the rest of the 30 days from the reset, and while that hold stands the member picks that nickname, exactly as it was taken away, with no change interval, even after a pick since the reset, once (taken back and given up again, it keeps the interval, as any other nickname does). One cancelled already is `cancelled`; one on the acting admin is `own`; an account restriction is cancelled only by an approved request (`approval_required`)

Bring a standing writing restriction’s end forward (감경) to `endsAt`, with a reason (recorded, operators only): still to come (`end_passed` otherwise — a lift ends it now) and earlier than its end now (`not_earlier`; any is, for one with no end). Not a writing restriction is `not_restriction` — an account restriction `approval_required`, its end moving only by an approved request — a cancelled one `cancelled`, one ended `ended`, one on the acting admin `own`. The member reads the new end

Lift a standing writing restriction early (조기 해제), with a reason (recorded, operators only): it ends now and stays on the record as given. Refused as a shortening is (`not_restriction`, `approval_required`, `cancelled`, `ended`, `own`)

get.summary: A post whatever its state (the deleted original too), its earlier versions, the reports on it with their reporters, its actions and its author’s record of actions. On a record about the admin reading it, no reporter, report description or operator (`aboutViewer`)

post.summary: Hide a post with a reason: out of every list, its placeholder on its page, no new comment, no edit by its author. Resolves the pending reports on it (조치함). A deleted post is `deleted`, a hidden one `hidden`, the acting admin’s own `own`

get.summary: A 댓글 or 대댓글 whatever its state, its earlier versions, its post, the reports on it, its actions and its author’s record of actions

post.summary: Hide a 댓글 or 대댓글 with a reason, as a post. Resolves the pending reports on it (조치함)

get.summary: A member’s public profile now (its image at its operator address), the reports on it and every action on the member, with what profile actions took away

schema.description: A member’s public id (10 lower-case letters and digits, never the account id), matched ignoring case; anything else is NOT_FOUND

get.summary: The same page as `GET /admin/moderation/users/{userId}`, found by the public id of the profile’s address — the way from a public profile’s operator link

post.summary: Warn a member with a reason: a record and the member’s notice only. With a subject (the member’s post, comment or profile) its pending reports are resolved (조치함); one not the member’s is `not_theirs`; an account its member closed (탈퇴) is `closed`

Restrict a member’s writing (작성 제한) with a reason, for `days` (1, 3, 7 or 30) or with no end (`null`, until lifted): no new post, comment or reply, no edit of their own and no new value of a public profile item (RESTRICTED, with the end) — deleting their own, likes and reports stay open. Restricted already, the one that ends later governs. With a subject (the member’s post, comment or profile) its pending reports are resolved (조치함); one not the member’s is `not_theirs`; the acting admin is `own`; an account its member closed (탈퇴) is `closed`

Give a member’s nickname back to an auto nickname with a reason; the nickname taken away is kept for operators and held from every account for 30 days (from the member too, until the reset is cancelled), and the member’s 30-day change interval is waived (they pick a new one at once). An auto nickname already is `nothing_to_remove`. Resolves the pending reports on the profile (조치함)
Empty a member’s 소개 with a reason; it is kept for operators. None is `nothing_to_remove`. Resolves the pending reports on the profile (조치함)
Remove a member’s profile image with a reason: served to nobody from then on and kept for operators. None is `nothing_to_remove`. Resolves the pending reports on the profile (조치함)

get.summary: The account restriction requests: `pending` (default) — those waiting for another admin’s decision, the one waiting longest first, each with what approving it would be refused for now (`moot`) — `decided` — approved or rejected, the latest decision first — or `retracted` — retracted by the admin who asked, the latest first. No asking or deciding admin and no operators’ memo on a request about the admin reading it (`aboutViewer`)

post.summary: Ask for a member’s account to be restricted (계정 제한) for `days` (1, 3, 7 or 30) or with no end (`null`), with a reason and the explanation the member will read (required). Nothing is in force until another admin approves the request: then no new order, market proposal, public profile item’s new value or account closing (RESTRICTED, with the end) — writing, likes, reports and the watchlist stay open, and the term counts from the approval. With a subject (the member’s post, comment or profile) its pending reports are resolved on approval (조치함); one not the member’s is `not_theirs`; the acting admin is `own`; an account its member closed (탈퇴) is `closed`; with no admin but the acting one and the member to decide it, `no_decider`. An optional `memo` is for the operators (not the admin it is about), never the member

Ask for a standing account restriction’s end to be brought forward (감경) to `endsAt`, with a reason (operators only), done once another admin approves: still to come (`end_passed`) and earlier than its end now (`not_earlier`; any is, for one with no end). Not an account restriction is `not_account_restriction`, a cancelled one `cancelled`, one ended `ended`, one on the acting admin `own` — each asked again on approval — and with no admin but the acting one and the member to decide it, `no_decider`

Ask for a standing account restriction to be lifted early (조기 해제), with a reason (operators only): once another admin approves, it ends then and stays on the record as given. Refused as a shortening is (`not_account_restriction`, `cancelled`, `ended`, `own`, `no_decider`)

Ask for an account restriction to be cancelled (취소), with a reason (operators only): once another admin approves, it ends at once and the member reads it cancelled — an ended one too. Not an account restriction is `not_account_restriction`, a cancelled one `cancelled`, one on the acting admin `own`, and with no admin but the acting one and the member to decide it `no_decider`

Approve an account restriction request, with a reason, and do what it asks in the same transaction: restrict the account from now (its term counted from now), bring its end forward, lift it or cancel it. The admin who asked cannot (`APPROVAL_NOT_ALLOWED` `requester`), nor the member (`own`); a decided request is `decided`, a retracted one `retracted`; what the restriction outgrew since the request is refused (`cancelled`, `ended`, `not_earlier`, `end_passed`) — reject it instead — and so is a restriction of an account its member closed (`closed`). Answers the request and the restriction as it stands

Reject an account restriction request, with a reason: nothing is done. Requests do not expire. The admin who asked cannot (`requester`) — they retract it instead — nor the member (`own`); a decided request is `decided`, a retracted one `retracted`

Retract an account restriction request the acting admin made, before anyone decides it: nothing is done, and it closes as `retracted` with when — decided by no one after. Anyone else is refused (`APPROVAL_NOT_ALLOWED` `not_requester`), and so is one decided (`decided`) or retracted (`retracted`) already. Answers the request

get.summary: Any stored image, whatever shows it, for operators. Revalidated on every use (ETag)

The repeated-link review list grouped by link and rule (the same person put the link in 3 or more posts and comments within 24 hours, or 3 or more people did): `open`, the entries no operator has marked, newest group first; `reviewed`, one row per mark, newest first
A review-list group's entries, newest first: those of the link and rule no operator has marked, or with `reviewId` those that mark covered — each with the item as it is now

post.summary: Mark a review-list group '확인함' with what came of it (no_issue or actioned) and an optional note, recorded: its unmarked entries put on the list at or before `through` leave the default list

get.summary: What closing the account would do now: the Coin it forfeits, what refuses it, whether the start Coin was paid to it — its number gets none again — and whether a market proposal of it is still being processed (탈퇴, #140; #77)

get.summary: What the daily retention purge deleted, newest run first: kind, count, the period applied (days), the run’s instant and its outcome (`failed`, count 0, for a kind the run gave up on). A page never ends inside a run: `limit` records, then the rest of the run the last of them belongs to

One proposal with its proposer, who started the review and decided it, and when

reviewing → adopted, final: an optional memo for the proposer, and optionally a draft market made from the proposal or an existing market. Opens nothing and grants nothing

A slug any category has or a name a sibling has is refused naming the field, and so is a parent that is a sub-category or hidden; an unknown parent is NOT_FOUND naming parentId
